## Core Capabilities & Services
1. Kinetic Typography & Title Sequences: Expressive text choreography, weighted cubic-bezier easing curves and custom graph editor pacing in Adobe After Effects.
2. 9:16 High-Retention Social Reels: Vertical motion graphics engineered to hold viewer attention during the critical first 3 seconds on Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
3. Vector Asset Staging & Transitions: Custom layered artwork prepared from scratch in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop before keyframe animation.
4. Multi-Platform Masters & Clean Source Files: Lossless ProRes and lightweight web MP4 exports in 9:16 and 16:9 with organized .AEP project folders.

## Production Suite

- Matte & Color Treatment: Adobe Photoshop (texture synthesis, photo touch-ups, color balancing)
- Export Pipeline: Adobe Media Encoder (ProRes 422, H.264, WebM)
